description: Maps NI local-government result rows whose manifest constituency name does not slugify to their existing authoritative raw source file (historical apostrophe / ampersand / missing council-prefix naming, e.g. 'Area-G' -> belfast-area-g.json, "Giant's Causeway" -> giant-s-causeway.json). Surfaces already-present source candidate data; no values are synthesised. Resolved by cross-checking the Wikipedia STV election-box valid poll and seats against the raw file in the same election date directory.
provenance: Wikipedia gap audit 2026-06-28; raw files verified present in election-viewer-package/data/elections/local-government/<date>/.
